categories.main_business_segments: CSG Smart Science & Technology Co., Ltd. primarily operates in two main business segments: Digital Energy and Intelligent Robot Applications. The Digital Energy segment focuses on intelligent power distribution equipment and energy storage systems for power grids and large energy-consuming industries. The Intelligent Robot Applications segment provides customized non-standard intelligent robot products and comprehensive solutions for industries such as automotive, new energy, and rail transit.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company leverages core technologies in intelligent power distribution, energy storage, advanced control of robots, and artificial intelligence. It develops products such as intelligent medium-voltage circuit breakers, digital environmental gas insulated ring main units, smart terminals, low-voltage intelligent circuit breakers, and energy routers. Manufacturing methods include integration of advanced manufacturing, information, and intelligent technologies, with a focus on deep learning AI algorithms, 5G, IoT, and low-power technologies. The company also emphasizes R&D in flexible assembly systems for new energy vehicle batteries and lightweight carbon fiber robotic arms.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers include national and regional power grid companies such as State Grid and Southern Grid, large energy-consuming enterprises in petrochemical, steel, and metallurgy sectors, as well as automotive, new energy, rail transit, and engineering machinery industries. The company serves both domestic markets, especially in the Yangtze River Delta, Pearl River Delta, and Beijing-Tianjin-Hebei regions, and is expanding into overseas markets including Southeast Asia, the Middle East, and Australia.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates primarily in China with significant market presence in East China, South China, North China, Central China, Southwest, Northeast, and Northwest regions. It has begun expanding overseas into Southeast Asia, Middle East, and Australia. The company’s registered office and main operations are based in Shanghai and Hefei, with subsidiaries and branches across multiple Chinese provinces and cities.
categories.supply_chain_position: CSG Smart operates mainly in the midstream and downstream segments of the supply chain. It manufactures intelligent power distribution equipment and energy storage systems (midstream) and provides integrated solutions and services to power grid operators and industrial customers (downstream). It also develops and integrates intelligent robotic systems tailored to customer needs, positioning itself as a system integrator and solution provider.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company’s strategic focus is on accelerating development in digital energy aligned with new power system construction and carbon neutrality goals. It prioritizes R&D in intelligent power distribution, energy storage, AI-driven control systems, and integration of 5G, IoT, and quantum encryption technologies. The company invests heavily in developing new products such as smart terminals, digital environmental gas insulated ring main units, and flexible battery assembly systems. It also emphasizes talent acquisition and collaboration with leading universities and research institutes to maintain technological leadership.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is primarily generated through direct sales of intelligent power distribution equipment, energy storage systems, and customized intelligent robot products. Sales are mostly secured via bidding and tendering processes with large power grid companies and industrial clients. The company also provides lifecycle services including installation, maintenance, and technical support, contributing to service revenue. All sales are conducted through direct sales channels.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: CSG Smart is positioned as a leading domestic supplier in the intelligent power distribution and energy storage market with a strong foothold in the digital energy sector. It holds leading market shares in circuit breakers, ring main units, and energy storage installations in high energy-consuming commercial and industrial sectors. In intelligent robotics, it is recognized as a benchmark enterprise with extensive applications in automotive, new energy, and rail transit sectors. The company faces intense competition in the intelligent manufacturing and robotics industries, which are characterized by rapid technological advancement and increasing market entrants.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, the company reported total operating revenue of approximately RMB 2.74 billion, representing an 11.72% decrease from the previous year, primarily due to divestitures. Excluding divested entities, revenue grew by 16.76%. Net profit attributable to shareholders turned positive at RMB 70 million, a significant turnaround from prior losses. The company’s total assets stood at about RMB 4.89 billion with net assets of RMB 1.65 billion. It has shown a recovery trend with improved profitability and cash flow generation.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: CSG Smart emphasizes its comprehensive 'source-grid-load-storage' integrated digital energy solutions, combining advanced intelligent power distribution equipment with energy storage and AI-driven control systems. Its products are differentiated by high reliability, environmental friendliness, and deep integration with new energy scenarios. The company offers customized intelligent robot solutions tailored to complex industrial applications, supported by strong R&D capabilities and a robust service system. Its competitive edge lies in technological innovation, extensive industry experience, strong customer relationships, and a broad product portfolio that addresses evolving market demands.
